Controlled microhabitat: these temperature and food settings act on the rabbit cohort, not on the whole island climate. Predation is not modeled inside this experiment. Illustrative single-locus model: three insulation alleles, annual cohort replacement, 0.2% offspring mutation, selection and random reproductive sampling. Food limits carrying capacity. Cold favors insulation; heat favors thinner coats. No speciation or measured genetic forecasts.
